concept.title: Contact first before attending
concept.shortdesc: People must get in touch with the service, by phone, email or form, before they come, for example to check eligibility, discuss needs or confirm a date.

keywords.keyword: need to get in touch first
speak to someone before turning up
email first to check if I can come
call to find out if I qualify

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: must call to discuss needs beforehand
registration required: belongs in a neighbouring group that is not yet a category (formal sign-up rather than a first conversation)
no referral required: see (says what is not needed)
